# EROFS fixture provenance

Fixtures and integration tests come from lamco-admin/lamfold commit
`fabaad6af0c28b80535307b339b84110f3a3c12e`, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
They were generated by mkfs.erofs 1.8.6 and 1.9.4; see the original tests'
content formulas and the retained regenerate*.sh scripts. All source bytes
are unchanged except hole_full.erofs, whose stale superblock CRC32C is
repaired so the intentional unsupported-hole index can still be reached.
Source URL, checksums and sizes are recorded in manifest.json.
